---
title: "`rcl`: read from the Revised Common Lectionary"
---


The [`rcl` github repository](https://github.com/neelsmith/rcl) hosts data and a web app for reading selections assigned in the [Revised Common Lectionary](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Revised_Common_Lectionary).




- **Use the app**: hosted at [https://neelsmith.github.io/rcl/rcl.html](https://neelsmith.github.io/rcl/rcl.html)
- **More info**: [about the app](./about/)
